platform.description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the nreljed/platform engine package. Use for routes, RBAC, deploy pipeline, notifications, media, core frontend kit, and anything under packages/platform. Edit here, tag, then composer update the consumer -- never patch packages/platform directly.

blog.description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the blog package (posts, categories, tags, content blocks, scheduled publishing). Use for anything under packages/blog.

shop-module.description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for packages/shop-module (products, customers, orders, cart, coupons, checkout). packages/shop-module is a MIRROR -- author changes here, tag, then re-sync the mirror. Do not patch the mirror directly.

booking-module.description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for packages/booking-module (bookings, reservations, properties, availability). packages/booking-module is a MIRROR -- author changes here, tag, then re-sync the mirror.

laravel.shop.description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for apps/laravel.shop, a full app mirror that deploys independently to shop.laravel.tunispromo.tn. A fix authored under apps/laravel.shop does NOT ship -- it belongs in this repo.

laravel.booking.description: SOURCE OF TRUTH for apps/laravel.booking, a full app mirror that deploys independently. A fix authored under apps/laravel.booking does NOT ship -- it belongs in this repo.

scoped-packages.description: Mirror boundary + upstream dev loop for packages/**. READ BEFORE editing anything under packages/** or apps/**.

scoped-frontend.description: Frontend conventions: TSX style, page resolution, theming, workspace deps. Read when touching resources/js/** or any TSX/Tailwind work.

scoped-scripts.description: Scripts, tooling and deploy pipeline: runners, commands, CI wiring. Read when touching scripts/**, .github/**, hooks, or deploys.

scoped-tests.description: PHPUnit + Vitest layout, factories, Playwright MCP. Read when running, writing, or debugging tests.
